blocks.text: ADCD compliance is mandatory for any gas system installation or modification in Abu Dhabi, and Firestone manages this process end to end on behalf of our clients, including your gas installation certificate. We prepare and submit technical drawings, material submittals, and risk assessments in the format required by Abu Dhabi Civil Defence, drawing on established relationships with inspection bodies to keep approvals moving and your facility certified and operational.

We deliver gas system installation projects across Abu Dhabi,Al Ain, serving hospitals, hotels, residential towers, commercial properties, and industrial facilities. Looking for a gas company in Abu Dhabi or gas installation in Dubai? We're already active in both.

Firestone Fire and Security Systems has delivered fire and gas safety solutions across the UAE since 2007, holding approvals from ADCD, DCD, SCD, and SIRA. As a trusted gas installer and gas installation company, our certified engineers manage every gas system project end to end, from design through installation, compliance, and ongoing maintenance, as a single point of contact.

items.q: How do I get gas installed in my property?
items.a: Getting gas installed starts with a site assessment to determine gas load and the best system type — LPG, central, or a hybrid setup — followed by design, DOE/ADCD approval, and installation. As a certified gas installation company, we manage the entire process end to end.

items.q: How long does gas system installation take?
items.a: A straightforward residential or small commercial gas system installation typically takes 1–2 weeks once approvals are in place; larger commercial or industrial projects with more complex distribution networks can take longer depending on scope. Approval timelines with civil defence and DOE run separately and vary by emirate.

items.q: Do I need a certified gas contractor, or can a plumber install my gas system?
items.a: Gas system installation must be carried out by a licensed, Civil Defence-approved gas installer — general plumbing contractors aren't certified for gas system design, pressure regulation, or DOE/ADCD compliance submissions, and using an uncertified installer can invalidate your compliance certification entirely.

items.q: What compliance certificates are required for a gas system installation?
items.a: Every gas system installation in the UAE requires DOE approval and, in Abu Dhabi, ADCD sign-off — together covering your gas system compliance certificate and gas installation certificate. We handle the technical drawings, submissions, and documentation as part of every project.

items.q: How much does gas system installation cost?
items.a: Cost depends on system type, gas load, and property size — an LPG cylinder setup and a central distribution network for a commercial tower are priced very differently. Our quotes are based on a site assessment rather than a flat rate, and we aim to keep every project competitively priced for the scope involved.

items.q: Which areas do you cover for gas installation?
items.a: We deliver gas system installation projects across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah, and Fujairah — for hospitals, hotels, residential towers, commercial properties, and industrial facilities.

items.q: Are you a gas installation company in Abu Dhabi and Dubai?
items.a: Yes — Firestone is a Civil Defence-approved gas company in Abu Dhabi and an active gas installation provider in Dubai, alongside coverage across the wider UAE.

items.q: How do I start a gas system installation project?
items.a: Contact us for a site assessment — we'll evaluate your gas load and property layout, recommend the right system type, and handle design, approvals, and installation from there as a single point of contact.
